name: Stripe go-live — webhook PM2 + /stripe-status
goal: Three deliverables: (1) ecosystem.config.js: add kognai-stripe-webhook PM2 process (agents/stripe/server.ts, autorestart=true, STRIPE_* env passthrough). (2) commands.ts: add handleStripeStatus() owner-only command — shows env var check (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY/PRICE_GROWTH/PRICE_PREMIUM/WEBHOOK_SECRET set vs missing), active subscriber count, webhook port, ping agents/stripe/server.ts /health endpoint, list next steps. (3) commands.ts: update /subscribe line in handleHelp() from '(coming soon)' to 'Subscribe to TikTok Agent ($19/$49/mo)'. (4) index.ts: import + route /stripe-status.
rationale: Stripe code (client.ts, webhooks.ts, server.ts) is built but the webhook server has no PM2 entry — it never runs. /subscribe shows 'coming soon' blocking subscriber acquisition. /stripe-status gives operator a Telegram-native checklist to verify Stripe is live before accepting subscribers.
swarm: NOT USED — 3 small file edits + 1 validation script. Direct write.

tasks.title: commands.ts — add handleStripeStatus() + update handleHelp() /subscribe line
tasks.description: handleStripeStatus(chatId, ownerChatId): owner-only gate. Checks env vars: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY (✅ set / ❌ missing), STRIPE_PRICE_GROWTH (✅/❌), STRIPE_PRICE_PREMIUM (✅/❌), STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET (✅/❌). Shows STRIPE_WEBHOOK_PORT (default 3001). Pings http://127.0.0.1:{port}/health with 2s timeout — UP/DOWN. Shows TelegramDB.activeCount() subscribers. Calculates readiness: all 4 env vars set + webhook UP = '🟢 LIVE'. Missing any = '🔴 NOT LIVE — see above'. Shows next steps if not live. Update handleHelp(): change '/subscribe — Upgrade your plan (coming soon)' to '/subscribe — Subscribe to TikTok Agent ($19/$49/mo)'.
